The joint law violation on actual kernel output is decisive. Also the dependence explanation: any linear folding gives keep_j = parity(seed & mask_j) ^ offset_j. Dependence of masks {3,4,6,7}: 30^667^324^961 = let's trust probe = 0. So the joint pattern of those four channels is constrained to 8 of 16 patterns, error 1/16 = 0.0625. Confirmed.
